_README: Per-species edits applied on top of the Grove 2.3 seed.json when step 1
(prepare-assets) copies it into the gitignored data/assets/presets/.
This file exists because data/assets/ is gitignored: a preset edit made
only there is invisible to review and disappears on the next clean
rebuild. That is not hypothetical -- the drop_decay_curve/drop_weak_curve
ramps below were documented in docs/reference/grove-preset-reference.md,
guarded by prepare_assets.py's copy-skip check, and referenced by
config/growth_models.toml as already applied, yet were absent from every
preset on disk. Keep species tuning here, not only in data/assets/.
Name'). Values are merged shallowly into the preset dict.
Grove properties (plain numbers/bools) are passed straight to Grove.
Keys ending in _curve are a growpy convention, not Grove properties:
src/growpy/config/preset_overrides.py reads them into PresetOverrides and
applies them per cycle during simulation.
Anything here is a DELIBERATE departure from the Grove author's preset,
so every entry carries a why.
_why_drop_curves: PROBLEM. Under Grove's Surround shell, 7 of the 11 dataset species grow
normally to 12-23 m and then lose structure outright. Measured
2026-08-22 at r05 (the tightest configured radius) with
data/tmp/run25m/seed_probe.py, tracing height every cycle -- peak height
reached vs height when the run stopped:
common_ash      23.4 -> 0.6      silver_birch    12.3 -> 1.4
wild_cherry     20.6 -> 4.4      silver_fir      18.1 -> 5.1
norway_spruce   17.1 -> 6.5      european_oak    19.6 -> 12.7
scots_pine      20.5 -> 13.6
(douglas_fir, european_beech, small_leaved_linden and sycamore_maple
hold 25 m and need no patch.)
WHY IT WENT UNNOTICED. Step 4's plateau detector ratchets on historical
maximum height, so a collapsing tree reads as a plateaued one: the run
stops, the milestone ladder just ends short, and the pipeline still exits
0. Raising plateau_cycles from 5 to 15 changed nothing, which was read at
the time as confirming 'Grove's competition model working as configured'.
It is not -- the tree is falling apart.
WHAT CAUSES IT. Sustained shade, not the yield-table calibration: the
same collapse happens with the calibration curve off, never happens at
r00, and scots_pine at r05 reaches 25 m clean when uncalibrated.
FIX. Ease drop_decay / drop_weak in from 0 instead of applying them from
cycle 0 -- the remedy documented in
docs/reference/grove-preset-reference.md under 'Preventing tree death
(recommended for high cycle counts)'. Each ramp ENDS at that species'
own Grove value, so the mature tree is unchanged; only how quickly the
drop terms come into force differs.
RESULT at r05, calibrated (same probe): every patched species reaches the
full h05..h25 ladder and holds its height --
common_ash 25.6, scots_pine 25.2, norway_spruce 25.2, silver_fir 25.2,
wild_cherry 25.3, silver_birch and european_oak likewise recovered.
silver_fir also verified at r10 (25.2, was 19.1 -> 10.8).
Re-check this table after any change to surround radii/density, to the
yield-table calibration, or to growth_cycle_limit.
